title: Constructor.io pricing - Custom enterprise contracts averaging $150,000/year
clean_text: Constructor.io does not publish pricing and negotiates custom enterprise contracts. Industry data indicates an average contract value of approximately $150,000 per year, with proposed pricing sometimes reaching $300,000 depending on scope. A free trial and a multi-week Proof Schedule evaluation process are available before committing to a paid contract. Pricing for the recommendations module specifically is tied to A/B-tested performance outcomes rather than a fixed rate.
